Container.Name: mediaexplorer
Container.Overview:
MediaExplorer v0.1.16 — hierarchical image/video browser (NVDEC GPU decode; MX_HWACCEL=none forces CPU).
Add media shares at /media1../media8 (read-write: the .mxthumbs store is written beside the media; a read-only share still works but its thumbnails fall back to the data path) — each mounted dir becomes a browsable location automatically.
Rename a location with the MEDIA_N_NAME variable. Thumbnails + DB live in the data path.
UI: http://[IP]:[PORT:8000]/

Config.Name: APP_NAME
Config.Description: Name shown in the app title bar

Config.Name: media1
Config.Description: Media share 1 (browsable location, read-write: thumbnails are stored beside the media)

Config.Name: media2
Config.Description: Media share 2 (read-write; leave empty to disable)

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Driver capabilities for the GPU: NVDEC needs video (default is utility,compute)
Config.Help: Leave as all with --gpus all. Without video here, ffmpeg reports: No device available for decoder.

Config.Name: MX_HWACCEL
Config.Description: Video frame decode: cuda = NVDEC GPU (needs --gpus all), none = CPU only
Config.Help: Leave cuda unless the GPU is unavailable or shared.

Config.Name: MX_ANIM_MAX
Config.Description: Max videos per scan that pre-build hover filmstrips (0-500); above that they build on hover
Config.Help: Lower = faster scans on huge folders; filmstrips still appear on hover.

Config.Name: MX_WIPE_ON_BUILD
Config.Description: Wipe all thumbnails when the version changes (fresh start per build; 0 = keep)
Config.Help: Testing convenience. Keyed on version, so a plain restart keeps built thumbs. Turn off once the real library is in use.

Config.Name: MX_VIDEO_JOBS
Config.Help: Raise with spare cores on a GPU-less box.

Config.Name: MX_THUMB_WORKERS
Config.Description: Thumbnail encode threads. 0 = auto: cores minus the pack and ffmpeg pools, capped at 24
Config.Help: Raise to 16 for faster big-folder builds; lower if it competes with ffmpeg or other containers.

Config.Name: Password protect
Config.Description: 1 = ask for a password before the library loads (0 = open)
Config.Help: Casual lock for the household, not a security boundary: one shared password, remembered in a browser cookie for 30 days. Set the password below.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password asked for when Password protect is 1 (leave empty to disable)
Config.Help: Changing it signs every browser out. Stored as a salted hash, never in plain text.
